note: Storage list methods with nothing to bound what they return, and the calls outside src/storage that read a whole table through one (scripts/check-unbounded-lists.ts). Seeded 2026-10-20 from the QA audit of 2026-10-16 (P7-10). An entry under methods is DEBT, a known unbounded read nobody has judged yet, or the reason the list cannot grow. Answering one means giving the method a limit and a cursor, or replacing DEBT with that reason. wholeTableCalls counts calls with no arguments per file; a count may only fall, and the gate fails until a fallen count is lowered here. Re-seeding forgives every entry, so it is a decision to ask about, never maintenance.
